description: Queue a composition to render as its own proxy (File > Create Proxy > Still or Movie): adds a Render Queue item whose post-render action is Set Proxy. Render it with render_queue

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

kind.description: still: one frame; movie: the whole composition

outputFile.description: Absolute path of the proxy file; the extension should match the output module

outputModule.description: Output module template. Default "Photoshop" for a still when it exists, otherwise the default template

time.description: still: the frame, in seconds. Default the current time

name: create_proxy
title: Create Proxy
